textbookText: Ernst Haeckel (Ernst Heinrich Phillipp August Haeckel) was a german biologist, physician, naturalist, philosopher and artist, born on February 16, 1834 in Potsdam, Germany. He is famous for his contributions made to the biological sciences. He did research work in the field of zoology and taxonomy of radioloria, Porifera and annelida. He also proposed that the phylum monera and kingdom protista be included to the classification of living beings. Ernst Haeckel was greatly inspired by Charles Darwin and his book “origin of species”.
